name: sinus
concept: One glowing sine ribbon slithering side to side across black while its hue drifts.
visual_verdict: A single zig-zag ribbon with a dark-red halo, cycling red->yellow->green->cyan over 8 s; clean but a screensaver-from-1995 look, and at 3 waves on 32 px it reads as a triangle wave.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the spec; the idea itself is thin (one curve, hue-by-distance halo is barely visible).
action_notes: Fold into a 'Sine Ribbons' pattern (dna-helix-2d as the survivor) with a ribbon-count control (1 = this look, 2 = helix, N = layered additive ribbons with OKLCH hue offsets and depth-dimmed back strands); drop as a standalone.

name: Slime mold palette
concept: 'Rainbow smoke' growth: color creeps outward cell by cell, each new cell placed where its neighbours best match a random palette position, so colors clump into amoeba regions.
visual_verdict: Ragged orange/purple growth fills a 16x16 canvas in ~2 s, then sits as a static blocky patchwork for the remaining 30 s hold; the interesting part (growth) is over almost instantly and the canvas is visibly coarse on 32x32.
perf_smell: full O(cells x 8) neighbour rescan per placement (no frontier list); per-pixel render2D read-out instead of fillCanvas
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the core growth rule but drops the per-pixel neighbour map in favour of a fixed 16x16 grid, so on a 64x64 panel each cell is a 4x4 block; palette library shrunk from dozens to 5.
action_notes: Rewrite at panel-native resolution (canvas = gridWidth x gridHeight capped ~64x64) with a frontier list so each placement is O(frontier) not O(cells), place ~20-60 cells/frame so growth lasts ~20 s, render via renderBulk+fillCanvas (or paint loop), crossfade/dissolve the old image instead of a hard wipe; use OKLCH gradient palettes. Drop the vestigial 'rebuild neighbor map' trigger.

name: slow color shift
concept: Soft rainbow islands ~12 LEDs apart slosh back and forth while the palette drifts around the wheel.
visual_verdict: Strip waterfall shows evenly spaced saturated rainbow bars wobbling sideways on black; pleasant but generic, indistinguishable from several other sine-blob strip patterns.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; the idea (sin^4 islands + hue drift) is a one-liner and not worth a slot on its own.
action_notes: Absorb as a 'slosh' motion mode of a single colour-bands/islands strip pattern (motion: march | slosh, blob spacing in LEDs, hue spread in degrees); delete the standalone file.

name: slowflies
concept: Soft green fireflies drift slowly both ways along the strip, swell and fade over ~3 s, leaving dim blue-violet ghost trails.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows diagonal mint-green streaks drifting both directions with lingering indigo afterglow; calm and pretty on a strip, meaningless raster smear on a grid.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) buffers + full-strip peak-hold loop in beforeRender (renderBulk persistence does this for free)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec well, fixes the original's pool bugs; zero controls.
action_notes: Make fireflies the one strip-firefly pattern with a 'style' mode (blink | drift-with-ghost-trail | xmas colours) and real-unit controls (count, lifetime s, trail half-life s, fly/trail colour); implement as renderBulk: fade(halfLife-derived k) for the trail then draw arches with fillRange/setPixel using mode-max, no pixel arrays.

name: Infinite Snake
concept: Self-playing Snake on a 16x16 board with a smartness dial (flood-fill lookahead), death flash and live scoreboard vars.
visual_verdict: Identical frames to snake-2d-v2 (green snake with white head, pulsing red food on black); readable and lively.
perf_smell: per-pixel render2D readout of a 16x16 board (~96 ms/frame at 4096 px per its own v2 notes)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Byte-identical game to snake-2d-v2, which renders via fillCanvas at 1/7 the cost; delete this file and let v2 take the 'Infinite Snake' name.

name: Infinite Snake v2
concept: Self-playing Snake with smartness dial, death flash and scoreboard, painted once per board change into a 16x16 canvas and fillCanvas'd.
visual_verdict: Small green snake with near-white head hunting a red pellet on black; crisp and legible, but most of a 32x32 panel is empty black and the 16x16 board looks chunky.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Survivor of the snake-2d pair: rename to 'Infinite Snake', strip the long 'why v2' essay from the header, and add a Board Size control (or auto = gridWidth/2 capped 32) so a 64x64 panel gets a real game; consider a faint grid/border and a smoother head glide via splat between steps.

name: snake
concept: A comet with a linear tail laps the strip over a fixed rainbow gradient (or solid / two-colour fade modes).
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows one clean diagonal rainbow comet band; a textbook chaser, nothing more.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the trivial spec and improves it (tail as fraction, colour modes); the idea is not distinct enough to keep.
action_notes: Its three colour modes (rainbow-under-comet, solid, head-to-tail fade) become a Colour Mode on the single comet pattern; delete the file. Also clashes by name with the Snake game.

name: Soap 2D
concept: Domain-warped simplex noise: one noise field pushes the coordinates before a second is sampled, giving swirling soap-film/marbled smears.
visual_verdict: Gorgeous marbled swirls with dark veins, drifting smoothly from amber through green to blue; one of the best-looking frames in the range.
perf_smell: 3x simplex3 per pixel per frame (12k noise calls/frame at 4096 px, 49k at 16384)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Keep as the domain-warp showcase but evaluate the two warp fields on a coarse canvas (e.g. 16x16, bilinear-ish via fillCanvas of a 32x32 result or a warp lookup) so only the final field is per-pixel; add real-unit controls (flow speed s, warp strength %, scale, colour cycle s) and an OKLCH palette option.

name: sound - blinkfade
concept: Random pixels blink on and fade; a PI controller on displayed fill makes twinkle density volume-independent; hue drifts with time plus a pitch offset.
visual_verdict: Strip waterfall is a dim, low-contrast speckle in horizontal colour bands (whole strip shares one hue per moment); reads as noise, no visible beat response.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) + full-strip decay loop in beforeRender; accum feedback inside render
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, but the PI loop targets 20% average fill which makes the result look like uniform dim static rather than bursts.
action_notes: Fold into blink-fade as a 'Sound reactive' toggle: beat/energy drives spawn rate and decay; keep the PI auto-gain as a shared helper idea; render via renderBulk fade()+setPixel so no per-pixel arrays.

name: SOUND - lavablob
concept: Sound-gated lava lamp: product of three interfering waves makes blobs; a mid band gates brightness and loudness scales spatial frequency.
visual_verdict: Starts as one green blob, then as energy rises the zoom explodes into a rigid checkerboard lattice of tiny squares cycling cyan->magenta->orange; reads as a test grid, not lava.
perf_smell: none (cheap per-pixel waves)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec including its acknowledged bugs; the idea (loudness -> spatial frequency) produces a lattice, not blobs, and a hard-coded band 13 gate.
action_notes: Rewrite as a real sound-reactive lava lamp: 4-6 metaball/splat blobs in renderBulk (or a 24x24 simplex field + fillCanvas) whose size swells with bass, rise speed with energy, and core heat flashes on beats; drop loudness-as-zoom entirely.

name: sound - rays
concept: Chart recorder: a write head stamps dominant-tone loudness/pitch into circular buffers that scroll along the strip, with PI auto-gain.
visual_verdict: After a short black wipe-in the entire strip is solid full-brightness rainbow with a fine dither; auto-gain rails so there are no dark gaps or rays at all.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) history buffers (could be a renderBulk scroll of the persistent frame)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, but the 0.5 target on a squared value plus integral 150 boot bias saturates the display; the 'rays' never appear.
action_notes: One 'Sound Rays' pattern survives (keep the simpler name sound-rays, absorb the BPM file's tempo-driven scroll as a 'Speed: fixed | follow tempo' mode); fix the AGC so peaks, not the mean, hit full scale; scroll the persistent frame in renderBulk instead of two history arrays.

name: sound - rays Frequency-BPM Reactive 1
concept: Sound rays chart recorder whose scroll speed follows detected tempo, with a synthetic-sound fallback when no board is present.
visual_verdict: Effectively black for the whole 8 s (63/160 frames barely lit, faint brown haze); the AGC integral climbs too slowly to ever show a ray.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) history buffers
cleanroom_quality: Implements the tempo detector and fixes the window bug, but the output is dark under real-ish music; the silence fallback only triggers when the spectrum is exactly zero. Controls are bare 0..1 dials.
action_notes: Move the beat/tempo detector into sound-rays as the 'follow tempo' speed mode (BPM factor as a real multiplier), then delete this file; the long name and '1' suffix are not library-grade.

name: Sound & Music Spectrum Visualizer
concept: Flat spectrum analyser: ~10 strip segments low->high light with their band, with PI auto-sensitivity, rate-limited refresh and EQ.
visual_verdict: After a brief bass flicker the whole strip rails to a solid scrolling rainbow with only occasional dark ticks; segments are not distinguishable, no visible spectrum dance.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) (pix + segOf) smoothing per pixel per frame for 10 values
cleanroom_quality: Faithful incl. quirks, but the auto-gain + 3x overdrive ladder pins nearly everything to full; three 0..1 sliders act as switches (rainbow/shift/colour presets).
action_notes: Fold into one strip/grid spectrum analyser: smooth only the N band values (not per pixel), draw segments with fillRange in renderBulk, colour mode selector 0..2 instead of three pseudo-switch sliders, peak-normalised AGC.

name: Sound Reactive Color Fade
concept: Whole display one solid saturated colour that drifts slowly and snaps to the next of six anchor hues on each detected bass beat.
visual_verdict: Eight frames are eight different full-panel solid colours (green, yellow, purple, cyan...); a whole-panel strobe with no spatial content at all.
perf_smell: render2D per pixel for a single constant colour (should be renderBulk fill())
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: it is a colour-wash layer whose hue advances on beat; better as a scene wash layer with a beat-step binding than as a pattern
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; beat detector is reasonable but the visual idea is a solid wash. Controls are bare 0..1 dials; the light==-1 presence probe means it never reacts unless a board writes light.
action_notes: Delete as a pattern. Propose an engine/scene feature: a wash layer whose hue can be stepped by a beat event, and lift its bass-onset detector into a shared beat helper reused by the sound patterns.

name: sound - spectroblots - pow fade
concept: A folded fractal-noise field partitions space into amoeba blobs, one per spectrum band; each band's blobs flare on onsets and decay with a frame-rate-independent fade; mirror-symmetric.
visual_verdict: First three frames are blown-out white speckle with a mirror axis, then black for the rest; the 32-band noise partition is so fine it reads as pixel noise, not blobs.
perf_smell: perlinFbm (3 octaves) per pixel per frame for a band map that changes over minutes; array(pixelCount) persistence buffer
cleanroom_quality: Implements the spec, but with 32 bands over a triangle-folded fbm the blobs fragment into speckle and the fixed sensitivity 40 + excess-over-3x-average either whites out or goes dark.
action_notes: Becomes the 'noise blobs' field mode of a unified Spectrum Field pattern: cache the band-index map on a coarse canvas refreshed every ~0.5 s (it drifts over minutes), use 8-12 bands so blobs are big, trails via renderBulk fade() instead of a per-pixel array.

name: sound - spectrokalidamandala
concept: Concentric spectrum rings pulse from the centre; each ring is a band that flashes on onsets; hue from band plus mirrored angle; zoom breathes and rings drift radially.
visual_verdict: Concentric white-cored rings with rainbow fringes on black, changing scale across frames; striking but dominated by white and visibly aliased at 32 px.
perf_smell: hypot + atan2 per pixel per frame plus array(pixelCount) persistence buffer
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the mandala well and improves the AGC (relative step); 33% target fill plus whiteout over unity makes it too white-hot.
action_notes: Survivor of the spectrum-field family, renamed 'Spectrum Field': add a Field mode (rings | plasma | noise blobs | linear fold for strips) absorbing spectroblots, both spectromatrix files and kalidastrip; precompute per-pixel radius/angle once (or render a 32x32 canvas + fillCanvas), trails via renderBulk fade(), lower target fill and cap whiteout so colour dominates.

name: sound - spectro kalidastrip
concept: Strip spectrum with a sliding double-triangle mirror fold: per-band transients flare rainbow regions that decay as trails, with PI auto-gain.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows bold chevron/zig-zag bands, white-hot cores with rainbow edges, sweeping back and forth; energetic on a strip but heavily white.
perf_smell: array(pixelCount) persistence buffer; per-pixel band interpolation
cleanroom_quality: Faithful and better-controlled than the original (real-unit controls); whiteout dominates under steady music.
action_notes: Becomes the strip/'linear fold' field mode of the unified Spectrum Field pattern (same onset-over-average core); trails via renderBulk fade() rather than array(pixelCount).

name: sound - spectromatrix agc
concept: Two interfering waves pick a band per cell of a 16x16 canvas; only above-baseline energy lights, with trails, whitening peaks and PI auto-gain.
visual_verdict: Opens on two fully white frames, then a muddy, dim, blocky 16x16 plasma with faint purple/green ribbons; AGC overshoot is obvious and the canvas is chunky.
perf_smell: none (already 16x16 canvas + fillCanvas)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, already perf-converted; AGC start (integral 30) blows out the first second, 8% target leaves it murky.
action_notes: Its plasma band map becomes the 'plasma' field mode of Spectrum Field; keep its canvas+fillCanvas approach as the implementation model for all modes.

name: sound - spectromatrix render2D
concept: Same as spectromatrix agc: drifting plasma iso-bands mapped onto spectrum bands, onsets flash, trails, PI auto-gain.
technique: sensor + per-pixel render2D over a 16x16 persistence canvas
visual_verdict: Alternates between near-white blowouts with scattered blocks and dark frames; the AGC oscillates and the picture never settles into readable ribbons.
perf_smell: per-pixel render2D writing a shared 16x16 persist slot many times per frame (each slot decayed by every pixel that maps to it — a bug that scales with panel size)
cleanroom_quality: Near-duplicate of the agc variant; the persist[slot] update runs once per PIXEL so trails decay (pixelCount/256)x faster on bigger panels.
action_notes: Delete outright; spectromatrix-agc (and then Spectrum Field's plasma mode) covers it.

name: Sound - Spectrum Analyser
concept: Classic bar spectrum analyser: one bar per column (log band mapping), white falling peak dots, fast-scrolling rainbow, PI auto-gain.
visual_verdict: Legible rainbow bars with white peak dots bouncing, bass-heavy on the left; works, but the hard-coded width 16 makes 2 px bars on 32 wide and the right half is nearly always empty.
perf_smell: per-pixel render2D for what is N rectangles (fillRect per bar in renderBulk)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; keeps the original's hard-coded matrix width (the spec flags it as the obvious fix) and has no controls.
action_notes: Survivor of the spectrum-bar family: derive columns from gridWidth() (bar width control in px), renderBulk with fillRect per bar + a 1-row peak fillRect, add a strip mode (segments along the strip, absorbing sound-music-spectrum-visualizer), colour mode (scrolling rainbow | gradient by height | fixed), and fix the AGC so treble shows (per-band tilt EQ).

name: sound - Starburst 2
concept: Evenly spaced comet heads sweep one way while a mirrored set sweeps the other; rising energy flares heads and lengthens trails, falling energy snuffs trails and strobes hue.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows crossing head pairs that bloom into pastel striped mushroom/bowtie shapes on black, with white cores turning colour; unusual and fairly attractive.
perf_smell: 4x array(pixelCount) (pix, fade, sat, unused age); per-frame decay and saturation recovery done per pixel
cleanroom_quality: Faithful incl. the frame-rate-dependent decay and an unused age buffer; controls are a 0..1 count dial and a 0..1 pseudo-toggle.
action_notes: Drop the unused age array, scale decay by delta, convert to renderBulk: fade(k) chosen by rising/falling and setPixel the heads (white brush) — saturation recovery can be approximated by drawing a coloured 2-3 px tail behind each head; controls become 'Leaders' (count, step=1) and a real Rainbow toggle.

name: sparkfire
concept: Strip fire driven by accelerating ember sparks that deposit heat along their path; heat convects upward and cools.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows a blazing fire with white-hot core bands and red/orange streaks licking along the strip; lively but over-bleached — half the strip sits near white.
perf_smell: array(pixelCount) heat + two full-strip loops per frame (fine on strips, meaningless on a grid)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec and normalises pacing to strip length as the spec suggests; no controls, and the heat->white mapping is too generous.
action_notes: Consolidate the 1D fires into one 'Fire (strip)' pattern with an Ignition mode (random base heat | spark launches = this file) and Palette (red | blue | custom); bring spark count, cooling and launch speed out as real-unit controls and pull back the whiteout (sat bleach only above heat 1.5).

name: sparks center
concept: Grinder sparks shoot from the strip's middle in both directions, decelerating and dimming with speed, white-hot when fast, indigo when slow.
visual_verdict: Black almost the whole time (30/160 lit): one opening fountain arc, then a lone dim spark; the 'dormant until rare relight' change kills the effect.
perf_smell: array(pixelCount) cleared with a hand loop every frame (renderBulk clear()+setPixel needs none)
cleanroom_quality: Deviates from the spec in the harmful direction: the spec says stalled sparks relaunch immediately (constant fountain); the port makes them dormant at 0.02/s so the strip is dark. No controls.
action_notes: Becomes the 'launch from: centre' origin mode of a single Sparks pattern (start | centre | both ends), with immediate relaunch so the fountain is continuous; delete the file.

name: sparks
concept: A shower of white-hot embers shoots from the strip start toward the end, flaring fast then slowing, with short orange trails.
visual_verdict: Waterfall is a dense field of white dashes with faint dark-orange smears; reads as static/snow more than embers, trails barely visible at 20% persistence.
perf_smell: array(pixelCount) + feedback per frame (renderBulk fade()+setPixel is the same thing with no buffer)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful with good real-unit controls; trail decay is per-frame (frame-rate dependent) as the spec warned.
action_notes: Survivor of the sparks family: add Origin mode (start | centre | both ends) absorbing sparks-center, time-based fade, default persistence ~60% so trails read as embers, colour ramp white->orange->red by energy; implement as renderBulk fade()+setPixel.

name: spin cycle
concept: About five sharp bright bands race along the strip while their hues churn inside a rotating half-wheel window.
visual_verdict: Waterfall is a fast, busy hatch of thin multicolour diagonal dashes on black; restless and garish, no focal point.
perf_smell: pow-by-loop per pixel (trivial)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; the idea is a one-formula chaser that several other strip patterns already cover.
action_notes: Delete; the band-chaser look is covered by marquee-chase / color-bands, and nothing here is worth a mode.

name: Spinning Plasma 2D
concept: Perlin noise sampled through a rotating, centred transform: blue/magenta/teal plasma that turns slowly.
visual_verdict: Soft blue/magenta/teal blobs with occasional red, rotating; pleasant but generic plasma and the rotation is hard to perceive in noise.
perf_smell: perlin per pixel (acceptable) plus time(.1) evaluated per pixel instead of once in beforeRender
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Fold into a single noise-plasma showcase (soap-2d survivor) as a 'Rotation' speed control (0 = none) and a palette selector; the transform-rotation teaching point belongs in docs/lang.md, not the library.

name: Spinwheel 2D
concept: Mandala pinwheel: inverse-square hotspots on a jittered polar grid form petal points in rings; spin rate swells and ebbs, rings breathe.
visual_verdict: Almost black: a handful of isolated white dots and faint coloured star-rays scattered per frame; the 'petals' never form a flower at this scale.
perf_smell: atan2 + hypot + division per pixel
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the formula, but the unit-sized polar cells give ~1 ring and ~6 cells on a normalised map, so the idea collapses to a few points; no controls.
action_notes: Delete; the radial-mandala niche is better served by kaleidoscope-2d / zoom-kaleidoscope. If the 'gusty spin' driver is liked, give it to spiral-2d as a spin-wobble control.

name: Spiral 2D
concept: Rotating spiral arms from one wave() of angle and radius, centre-weighted, hue drifting with radius and time.
visual_verdict: Clean glowing 3-arm swirl on black, hue cycling magenta->orange->green->blue; tidy and readable, a bit small (vignette leaves corners black).
perf_smell: atan2 + hypot per pixel (could be a precomputed per-pixel angle/radius table)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: BUG: sliderArms has //# min=1 max=6 but computes 1+floor(v*5.99), so the UI's default 3 yields 18 arms — use floor(clamp(v,1,6)). Make it the spiral survivor: add Twist (wind/unwind, absorbing 2d-spiral-twirls and the star variant's shear), spin speed s, and an optional star/polygon mask mode.

name: spiral twirls star 2D
concept: A spinning hexagram mask filled with rotating rainbow spiral arms that wind and unwind.
visual_verdict: A small green/teal swirl blob with ragged spikes in the middle of a black panel; at 32 px the hexagram is unrecognisable and hue barely moves.
perf_smell: hexagram SDF + hypot + atan2 per pixel
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: the star is a mask — as a scene this is the spiral pattern layered under a star-shaped sprite/mask layer
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec but all eight controls are bare 0..1 dials (house-style violation) and the default star size is too small to read.
action_notes: Absorb as spiral-2d's 'Mask: none | star' option (or a scene: spiral + masked hexagram layer once scenes support shape masks); delete the file.

name: Spirograph 2D
concept: Two stacked rotations trace an evolving epicycle rosette into a fading trail canvas whose gear ratio breathes.
visual_verdict: Dim, blocky 16x16 dotted loops in a single shifting hue; the rosette never builds up because the trail fades before a lap completes.
perf_smell: render2D readout of a 16x16 canvas (renderBulk drawLine + fade() at native res is both cheaper and sharper)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Rewrite as the 'Curve Tracer' survivor absorbing lissajous-curve-tracer: renderBulk with fade(k) and drawLine segments between substeps at panel resolution, hue along the path, modes spirograph | lissajous | rose, real-unit trail-seconds and gear-ratio controls; long trails so the full rosette is visible.

name: spotlights / rotation 3D
concept: A white-hot double cone tumbles through the unit cube on a wandering axis, hue painted by world x.
visual_verdict: On the 2D slice it is black most of the time (71/160 lit) with an occasional dim green or violet smudge passing through; the idea only reads on a real 3D map.
perf_smell: per-pixel 3x3 matrix + sqrt (fine for 3D; wasteful as a 2D fallback)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; it is a second port of the same community idea as 3d-rotation-spotlights; controls are 0..1 dials quantised into steps.
action_notes: Same pattern as 3d-rotation-spotlights (same title reversed); keep one, give it a real-unit cone angle (degrees) and tumble speed (s), and make the 2D fallback project the cone (a sweeping spotlight disc) instead of slicing z=0; delete this file.

name: Spring Colors
concept: Every pixel independently glows in one of four warm palette hues, fades over seconds and relights at random brightness — a calm shimmering mosaic.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows vertical red/orange/amber streaks of varied length fading out; calm and warm, but just random twinkle.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) + full-strip loop every 40 ms tick
cleanroom_quality: Faithful and fixes the frame-rate quirk; 'Spring' name with a red/orange autumn default palette is confusing.
action_notes: One 'Palette Twinkle' pattern (autumn-colors survivor) with a Palette preset selector (autumn | spring pastel | halloween | xmas | custom pickers) and fade seconds; this file's weighted-accent pick and random relight brightness are the behaviours to keep.

name: Stacker
concept: 1D Tetris-ish filler: in each mirrored segment a block travels inward and locks onto a growing central pile until the segment fills and clears.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows three synced mirrored segments of red piles with fast blue blocks streaking in; it works but at the default speed the block is a flicker and the pile restarts constantly.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec; four of six controls are bare 0..1 dials quantised internally (speed, size, segments, colour mode).
action_notes: Keep as a playful strip filler: real-unit controls (block speed px/s, block width px, segments 1..6 step 1, colour mode 0..2 step 1), slow the default so stacking is watchable, add a short flash when a segment completes; renderBulk with fillRange per pile/block.

name: Stairmaster 2D
concept: Diagonal escalator steps march across the panel while a glowing ball in the middle bounces once per step.
visual_verdict: All eight frames look identical: four pale rainbow-tinted ramps bleaching to white at the bottom; the motion aliases to a standstill at 1 s sampling and the ball is barely visible.
perf_smell: hypot per pixel for a single ball (splat)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to a weak original; no controls.
action_notes: Delete — a washed-out ramp with a ball is not library-grade and nothing else depends on it.

name: Starfield 2D
concept: Warp-speed starfield: 18 stars fly at the viewer via perspective divide, streaking into a fading canvas.
visual_verdict: Sparse dim grey-blue specks scattered on black, no visible streaks or radial motion; reads as dead pixels rather than hyperspace.
perf_smell: render2D readout of a 16x16 canvas (renderBulk fade()+drawLine at native res is cheaper and sharper)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Rewrite as renderBulk: fade(k) for streaks, drawLine from previous to current projected position per star (mode 1 add), 60-120 stars scaled to panel size, brightness/size by depth, optional hue tint; warp control in real units (speed), centre offset for a 'banking' feel. Done right this is a 4.

name: StarGen polar 2D
concept: Self-advancing playlist of 12 polar figure animations (ellipse orbit, sinus star, hexagram, pentagram, decagram, heart, bird wingbeat, rainbow spirals, snowglobe sparks) with a stochastic shimmer crossfade.
visual_verdict: On a normal cartesian grid it renders garbage: a wavy vertical orange/yellow line, then white jitter — because it treats x as radius and y as angle; the figures never appear.
perf_smell: acos/cos/hypot per pixel per mode, random() per pixel during fades, array(pixelCount) for one mode
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: a 12-item auto-advancing playlist with crossfades is what the device playlist/scenes already do — split the good figures into individual patterns or scene items
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to a pattern that assumes a polar-coordinate map; useless on the panels Luxel targets. Controls are bare 0..1 dials (mode override quantised from 0..1).
action_notes: Rewrite as 'Polar Figures': compute r/angle from centred cartesian x,y (keep a toggle for polar-mapped discs), keep the 6-7 strongest figures (pentagram/hexagram/decagram star-polygon family, heart, wingbeat bird, rainbow spirals) as a Figure mode 0..n step 1 plus an auto-cycle toggle; drop the snowglobe sparks mode and the per-pixel random dissolve (use a scene/playlist crossfade instead).

name: Static Christmas Lights - 4 Colors
concept: Completely static repeating red/green/blue/yellow sequence like an incandescent light string.
visual_verdict: Static RGBY repeating 1 px pattern; on a grid it is a fine diagonal confetti stripe, no motion at all.
perf_smell: per-pixel render for a static frame (renderBulk would paint once)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to a trivial original.
action_notes: Becomes the 'twinkle off / static' setting of the one classic-strand Christmas pattern (palette RGBY, block size px); delete the file.

name: static random colors
concept: A frozen field of random per-pixel colours using a reseed-every-frame PRNG instead of an array.
visual_verdict: Identical confetti noise in all eight frames; a static test card.
perf_smell: hand-rolled xorshift per pixel per frame for an image that never changes
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; the 'trick' is a PB workaround Luxel does not need (deterministic seeding exists).
action_notes: Delete — static noise is utility/teaching material, not library content.

name: Sun rays through trees
concept: An off-screen sun above top-centre sends turbulent light shafts fanning down through drifting 'foliage' noise.
visual_verdict: Mostly black: a white smudge at the top centre with a few scattered amber flecks lower down; no recognisable shafts at default settings.
perf_smell: atan2 + hypot + 3-octave perlinTurbulence per pixel (heaviest in range, 0.54 ms/1024 px)
cleanroom_quality: Follows the spec closely, but the smoothstep(0.68,0.95) flare threshold kills nearly all light, so the god-ray idea is lost; three 0..1 dials violate house style.
action_notes: Rewrite the god-ray idea cheaply: per frame compute ~64 angular bins of 1D simplex noise (shaft occlusion), per pixel only look up bin by a precomputed angle table and multiply by a radial falloff + soft haze; warm OKLCH ramp, real-unit controls (shaft count, drift s, haze %). Should read as visible shafts across the whole panel.

name: Sunrise 2D
concept: A warm disc rises from the bottom, pauses, then boils as an active sun with granulation and gravity-looping flare particles; slider restarts.
technique: 16x16 canvas sim with hue+brightness packed in one number
visual_verdict: A tiny, very dim dark-red blob rises to the centre and sits there; the granulation and flares are invisible at this brightness and resolution.
perf_smell: render2D readout of a 16x16 packed canvas (fillCanvas would do it in one call); packed hue.brightness encoding is a PB-era memory hack
cleanroom_quality: Implements the described machinery, but brightness is squared from a mask-weighted value so the sun renders nearly black; a slider used as a restart trigger instead of a trigger control.
action_notes: The 'active sun with limb flares' belongs to coronal-ejection-2d; give that pattern an optional 'rise on start' intro and particle flares drawn with splat in renderBulk. Delete this file.

name: Sunrise Alarm Clock
concept: The strip is a slice of sky playing out the real day: dawn bloom before wake time, blue day sky with drifting clouds and a travelling sun, mirrored sunset before sleep time; plays a fast preview day on load.
technique: clock + per-pixel rgb sky + perlin clouds
visual_verdict: Preview day reads well: red dawn band, then a deep-blue cloudy sky with a white sun streaking end to end, vignetted ends; purposeful and pleasant.
perf_smell: perlin + 3x pow + sin-vignette pow per pixel per frame (0.57 ms/1024 px, second heaviest in range) for a sky that changes slowly
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec well, scales the sun with strip length; three 0..1 dials (cloudiness, vignette, gamma) and a pattern-level gamma control (should be the device output gamma).
action_notes: Survivor of the wake-light family: absorb sunrise.js as a 'one-shot sunrise now' trigger, drop the gamma slider (device setGamma exists), make cloudiness/vignette percent controls, precompute the vignette into an array once, and evaluate cloud noise on ~32 strip samples interpolated instead of per pixel.

name: Sunrise
concept: One-shot wake-up light: orange glow spreads from the centre until the strip is orange, then whiteness spreads until it is full white and holds; optional GPIO nightlight mode.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows the orange chevron spreading from the centre then a white chevron taking over and holding solid white; clean but it is a lamp program, done in ~6 s at the shipped speedup.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, including shipping the TEST speedup (100x, ~6 s) as the default and configuration via exported vars instead of controls; GPIO pin hard-coded.
action_notes: Fold into sunrise-alarm-clock as a 'Sunrise now (minutes)' trigger + duration control; drop the GPIO nightlight branch (device-level concern). Delete the file.

name: Sunset
concept: Slow interference plasma for indirect ambient light, showing only a narrow rotating wedge of the hue wheel so bounced light stays coloured.
technique: per-pixel plasma on a hard-coded 12-wide serpentine
visual_verdict: On a 32x32 grid it is scrambled magenta/red/teal pixel hash with diagonal shear — the hard-coded 12-wide serpentine decode turns the plasma into noise; no 'sunset' anywhere.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the original's hard-coded width, which is exactly what makes it broken on any real map; misleading name; MASTER brightness constant.
action_notes: The spec says it is a tweak of the honeycomb plasma: give matrix-2d-honeycomb an 'ambient wedge' palette mode (narrow rotating hue window + brightness-shifted cores) using real render2D coordinates; delete this file.

name: Swirlpool 2D
concept: A ring of orbiting dots with fading comet trails forms interlocking spiral arms whose orbit centres slowly morph between spread and collapsed.
visual_verdict: Blocky red/orange hooked-arm figures on black; at 16x16 the arms read as stepped L-shapes and several frames resemble a hooked cross — an unfortunate look for a shipped pattern.
perf_smell: none (already fillCanvas), but the 16x16 canvas is the quality problem
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec's motion, but the fixed 16x16 canvas and hue-product colouring keep it red and chunky; all four controls are bare 0..1 dials, one used as a toggle.
action_notes: Its N-arm orbiting epicycles are a mode of the rewritten Curve Tracer (spirograph-2d): renderBulk fade()+drawLine at native resolution with per-arm OKLCH hues, arms count step=1, morph seconds; default arm count 5+ and smooth curves avoid the hooked-cross look.

name: Synchronized Random Numbers
concept: Coding demo of an overflow-safe seedable LCG; visually a scrolling rainbow whose per-pixel hues random-walk into confetti.
visual_verdict: A plain diagonal scrolling rainbow that slowly gets jagged; nothing to look at.
perf_smell: software Russian-peasant modMul loop per pixel per frame — 2.26 ms/frame at 1024 px, by far the most expensive file in the range for the least output
cleanroom_quality: Faithful demo of a PB workaround; Luxel has deterministic seeding builtins (docs/lang.md 'Determinism and seeding'), so the point of the demo is moot.
action_notes: Delete — teaching scaffolding for a problem the engine already solves; if a sync-safe PRNG example is wanted it belongs in docs/lang.md.

name: Tetrix 2D
concept: Per-column Tetris-like stacker: each column drops random-colour blocks onto its pile at its own pace; a full column flashes and dumps.
visual_verdict: Colourful falling blocks over warm gradient piles building up, then a column flashing white; lively and readable, though columns are 2 px wide on 32x32 (hard-coded 16).
perf_smell: per-pixel render2D for what is 16x3 rectangles per frame (fillRect in renderBulk)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Columns and rows from gridWidth()/gridHeight() (or a column-width control), renderBulk with fillRect per pile/block/flash, real-unit controls (drop speed rows/s, block height range, palette), maybe a row-clear 'Tetris' moment across all columns when every pile passes a line.

name: Grinch's Heist
concept: Story pattern: a green thief creeps along a string of Christmas bulbs, snuffing each; when all are dark his heart grows, a golden ring relights them with a pop, then it repeats.
visual_verdict: On the 32x32 grid the string is drawn in index order, so it is just rows of small coloured dots with a green smear crossing — the story is illegible in 2D; on a strip (its real home) the design is charming.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Keep (one of the few narrative patterns); drop the render2D index-order alias or replace it with a real 2D take (bulbs on a drooping catenary across the panel, thief as a splat), and move to renderBulk with splat per bulb so 2D costs N splats rather than a per-pixel walk.

name: Three Red Pixels (array)
concept: Tutorial: three red pixels march over a solid blue strip, drawn via a hue buffer.
visual_verdict: Solid blue with three single red dots crawling; a tutorial screenshot, not content.
perf_smell: array(pixelCount) refilled by hand loop every frame to move 3 pixels
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to a tutorial.
action_notes: Delete — tutorial scaffolding; three-red-pixels-mathy already exists and is itself marginal.

name: Marching Dots
concept: Evenly spaced dots crawl over a solid background at a set px/s speed, found with one modulo per pixel.
visual_verdict: Saturated blue field with red dots marching (strip waterfall: blue with red diagonals); garish and plain.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the teaching point well and has good controls, but it is a teaching example.
action_notes: Its dot-count/width/background-colour controls fit marquee-chase (background colour picker + dot width px); then delete. The modular-arithmetic lesson belongs in docs.

name: Thunderstorm
concept: Strip storm: marching blue rain drops, random ember glints, irregular whole-strip amber lightning flashes, a shimmering white cloud block at the far end.
visual_verdict: Waterfall: regular blue diagonal rain lines with scattered orange glint noise, a white block at the end, two whole-strip amber flash rows; the glints and amber lightning read as wrong for a storm.
perf_smell: random() per pixel per frame for glints
cleanroom_quality: Fixes the spec'd hard-coded index and frame counting; the rain-density control is a bare 0..1 dial.
action_notes: lightning-strike is the realistic strip storm; add an optional rain layer (density in drops per metre/second) there and delete this file — the amber flash and ember glints are not worth keeping.

name: tixy
concept: tixy.land-style demo reel: a catalog of 20 tiny (t,i,x,y) formulas that auto-advance on a 16x16 grid, two-colour or value->hue display.
visual_verdict: For all 8 s it shows only the 'mondrian squares' sketch: a red/cyan block grid pulsing in brightness; crisp but the reel advances so slowly (~12 s per sketch) that a viewer sees one formula.
perf_smell: 20-way if-chain per pixel, random() per pixel in the noise sketches, hard-coded 16x16 quantisation
cleanroom_quality: Captures the reel idea with a fixed 20-formula catalog (spec describes ~60) and wraps the index as the spec suggests; three of five sliders are bare 0..1 dials, one used as a mode switch.
action_notes: Keep as the 'tiny formulas' showcase but derive the grid from gridWidth()/gridHeight() (formulas in cell units, centre computed), add a Formula selector (0..n-1 step 1, -1 = auto reel) and Sketch Seconds; drop formulas that duplicate standalone patterns and the per-pixel random() static ones.

name: Traffic
concept: Morphing moire line art: Minsky shear wobble, triangle-fold tiling and sin(contour) families whose density climbs, hot white line cores, hue cycling.
visual_verdict: Dim, thin purple and green diamond outlines on black that change between frames; on 32x32 the 1-px lines alias into dotted lattices and the whole thing reads dark.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; all five controls are bare 0..1 dials (mode and repeats quantised internally), and the default line width is too thin for LED panels.
action_notes: Rename (nothing to do with traffic) e.g. 'Moire Lattice'; default line width ~3x thicker, controls in real units (repeats 1..6 step 1, mode 0..3 step 1, speed s), and soften the shape-clock wrap so it does not jump.

name: tree setup pattern
concept: Static diagnostic for a 3D-mapped cone tree: four angular quadrant stripes (red/green/cyan/purple) with adjustable gap.
visual_verdict: Static four-colour bowtie/pinwheel of flat triangles on black, identical in every frame.
perf_smell: atan2 per pixel for a static frame
cleanroom_quality: Faithful utility.
action_notes: Delete from the library; map-orientation diagnostics belong in the mapper UI / a separate tools set, not shipped patterns.

name: Tunnel of Squares 2D
concept: Log-spaced, slightly twisted concentric squares spiral outward from the centre — a corkscrewing square tunnel with radial rainbow hue.
visual_verdict: Vivid twisted square spiral tunnel with saturated rainbow bands and deep black gaps, clearly moving between frames; strong on a panel.
perf_smell: log + atan2 per pixel (acceptable; a precomputed per-pixel log-radius/angle table would halve it)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec well; both sliders are bare 0..1 dials mapped internally (speed, ring count).
action_notes: Keep; make Speed rings/s and Rings per octave 1..7 step 1 real-unit controls, add twist angle (degrees) and a polygon-sides option (4 = squares, 3/6 for triangle/hex tunnels) for variety; optional OKLCH palette.

name: TV Simulator
concept: Glow of a TV through curtains for a vacant house: random scene cuts, in-scene flicker, rare white flashes.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows long blocks of a single violet or grey-teal level with subtle row flicker and two white flash rows; convincing as TV spill, not as a light show.
perf_smell: per-pixel render for a near-solid colour (renderBulk fill() or fillGradient)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Keep as the one 'presence simulation' utility (it has a real use); renderBulk with fillGradient for the spill falloff, add controls for scene length (s) and warm/cool bias, frame-rate-independent flash probability is already fine.

name: twinkle (2)
concept: Random pixels ignite at full brightness in a random hue from a slider-bounded wedge and fade to black.
visual_verdict: Sparse random rainbow single-pixel sparkles on black; generic confetti glitter.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) with a per-frame decay loop (renderBulk fade() + setPixel needs no arrays)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; all five controls are bare 0..1 dials (hue bounds should be degrees, ignition rate per second); decay is per-frame.
action_notes: Its hue-wedge colouring becomes twinkle's 'Colour: hue range' mode (low/high hue in degrees); delete the file and the '(2)' name.

name: Twinkle
concept: Icy star field: sparse blue-white glints flare fast and die slow with a gamma-shaped envelope, spawned in round-robin segments so they never clump.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows evenly spread frosty blue-white streaks with fast attack, slow tail; elegant and calm.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) + exp() per live pixel per frame (an envelope LUT or renderBulk fade() with a peak-then-decay trick would be cheaper)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec including the round-robin spread; good real-unit controls.
action_notes: Survivor of the generic twinkle family: add Colour mode (icy single colour | hue range | rainbow | palette) absorbing twinkle-2 and twinkly-stars; replace exp() per pixel with a small envelope lookup table; on a grid spawn by gridIndex so stars scatter in 2D.

name: Twinkling Classic Xmas Strands
concept: Classic multicolour strand: each bulb holds a balanced (urn-drawn) colour, bulbs twinkle from a dim rest to a bright swell, the strand cross-fades between vivid/pastel/cool palette moods.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows vertical bulb columns in red/green/amber/blue/purple at a dim resting glow with brief bright swells and pastel mood shifts; reads as a real strand.
perf_smell: random() per pixel per frame for blanks; 2x array(pixelCount)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec's signature urn assignment and palette moods well; two of four controls are 0..1 dials (one a pseudo-toggle).
action_notes: Survivor of the Christmas-strand family: absorb static-christmas-lights-4-colors (twinkle 0 + RGBY palette) and the christmas-lights block patterns as palette/bulb-size options; Auto-fade as a real toggle, Palette as 0..2 step 1, replace per-pixel random blanks with a hashed per-pixel schedule.

name: twinkly stars
concept: Steady full-brightness blue field; random pixels snap to white and ease back to blue over about a second.
visual_verdict: Waterfall: saturated blue field with white-to-blue vertical streaks scattered evenly; reads as a blue tree with glints, very bright overall.
perf_smell: random() per pixel per frame and state mutation inside render(); array(pixelCount)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful and properly time-based with good real-unit controls.
action_notes: Becomes twinkle's 'background colour' option (field colour picker + glint colour) — the only difference is a lit background; delete the file.

name: TwoColorHSVMix
concept: Sinusoidal blend between two picked colours scrolls along the strip, short-way hue interpolation, optional end-dimming window.
visual_verdict: Waterfall: red/blue/magenta diagonal stripes scrolling smoothly; a clean two-colour wash, nothing more.
perf_smell: pow(sin) per pixel when the envelope is on
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: a two-stop gradient wash scrolling is a scene colour-wash/ramp layer
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; two bare 0..1 dials (speed exponential, envelope power).
action_notes: One 'Two Colours' pattern survives with modes (static split | scrolling sine blend = this) and a cycle-seconds control; mix in OKLCH instead of short-way HSV for cleaner midpoints. Delete this file.

name: Typing Heatmap 2D
concept: QMK-style keyboard heatmap: keystrokes (real injected events or a phantom typist) deposit heat that diffuses and cools through a thermal palette.
visual_verdict: Very dark: faint navy haze with a few small magenta/red key hits; the thermal palette almost never gets past blue, so it reads as dim noise.
perf_smell: bilinear canvasGet per pixel (fine), but fillCanvas/paint loop in renderBulk would drop per-pixel entry
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Nice interactive idea (events/MQTT drive it); raise deposit heat and slow cooling so hot spots reach red/white, add a keyboard-row layout option and a typing-rate control; consider a 'touch glow' rename since its real value is reacting to injected events.

name: Unstable Orbits 2D
concept: 24 Lissajous dots whose vertical clock is a wave of the horizontal clock, tumbling with fading rainbow trails.
visual_verdict: Blocky rainbow dot chains in diagonal arcs with scattered orange specks; the motion is interesting but the 16x16 canvas makes it look pixelated and dotted.
perf_smell: render2D readout of a 16x16 canvas (renderBulk splat/drawLine at native res)
cleanroom_quality: Good real-unit controls; the canvas resolution is the limit.
action_notes: A 'swarm' mode of the rewritten Curve Tracer (spirograph-2d): N dots on the tumbling Lissajous, drawn with splat + fade() at panel resolution; delete this file.

name: Upward waves 3D using accelerometer
concept: On a mapped cube, rainbow ring bands climb against real gravity (accelerometer -> transform rotations); shaking flares the bands.
visual_verdict: On the 2D slice it is a concentric rainbow target that blinks on and off (44/160 lit) as the band crosses z=0; nothing rises.
perf_smell: hypot per pixel (fine)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the 3D cube idea; on 2D/strip fixtures (the bulk of Luxel installs) it is degenerate; six debug vars exported, no controls.
action_notes: Keep as the accelerometer showcase but give it a proper 2D path (bands rise along the tilt-corrected vertical in the panel plane, absorbing accelerometer-level-example), add band speed/count controls, and stop exporting the debug angle vars.

name: US Flag 2D
concept: Geometrically correct US flag (13 stripes, canton, staggered star lattice sized to the panel) waving as cloth with fold shading.
visual_verdict: Crisp, saturated, correct flag with a proper star lattice; the stripes ripple toward the fly end — legible and well-crafted, though stripe edges step jaggedly at 32 px.
perf_smell: mapPixels scan at startup to discover the grid (gridWidth()/gridHeight() now exist)
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: the static flag is a sprite; as a scene it would be a flag sprite plus a cloth-ripple/warp layer once scenes support displacement — worth proposing as an engine feature
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Survivor of the flag pair: replace the mapPixels min-step scan with gridWidth()/gridHeight(), fold us-flag's strip layout in as the render() path so one file serves both, and consider anti-aliased stripe edges for small panels.

name: US Flag
concept: US flag along a strip: blue canton with a row of stars, then red/white stripes, with travelling cloth shading and sway.
visual_verdict: Waterfall: blue block with white star columns then red/white stripes waving; reads as a flag only if you already know it is one.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Move this strip layout into us-flag-2d as its render(index) path (same controls: wave seconds, shading %, sway px, star twinkle %) and delete the file.

name: UtilityColorTemp
concept: Fills the display with one blackbody colour chosen by colour temperature (~1000..15000 K); bottom of travel auto-sweeps candle to daylight.
visual_verdict: Solid warm-to-white fill sweeping slowly; a lamp setting, not an effect.
perf_smell: per-pixel render for a constant colour (renderBulk fill())
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: a Kelvin-white wash is a scene/colour-wash layer setting, or a device 'solid white' mode
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; the temperature control is a 0..1 dial whose bottom 1/15 is a hidden demo mode instead of a real kelvin control.
action_notes: One 'Solid Colour' utility pattern survives with a Mode (picker | white by Kelvin) and a real kelvin control (1000..15000 step 100); drop the hidden demo sweep. Better still, expose Kelvin in the scene colour-wash layer.

name: Utility: Palettes
concept: A hand-rolled gradient-palette library (packed position.value stops, three interpolation modes) with a demo chase that switches palette every second.
visual_verdict: Waterfall flips every second between unrelated gradient bands (rainbow, blues, fire, browns, red/cyan); a palette swatch catalogue, jarring as a pattern.
perf_smell: linear stop search + closure dispatch per pixel per frame (0.59 ms/1024 px) for what setPalette()/paint() does natively
cleanroom_quality: Faithful library port, but Luxel has native setPalette/paint, OKLCH and setOutputPalette, so the library is obsolete.
action_notes: Delete; if the palette set is valued, ship the good ramps (fire, dawn, bvpoy, mint-pink) as named built-in palettes for paint()/setOutputPalette or scene ramps instead.

name: Voronoi 2D
concept: Bouncing seed points partition the panel by nearest seed; distance metric and draw style morph cells into orbs, rings, chessboard or bands.
visual_verdict: Five saturated cells with glowing cores (green/purple/yellow/blue/red) drifting; clean stained-glass orbs, a bit primary-coloured and static in mood.
perf_smell: hypot x seed count per pixel (0.69 ms/1024 px, heaviest original in range; ~2.8k hypot per frame at 4096 px x 8 seeds = 33k)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Compare squared distances (no hypot until the winner), or compute on a 32x32 canvas + fillCanvas for big panels; Speed should be a real unit that does not reseed positions when moved; add OKLCH palette and an edge-highlight style (F2-F1 borders) for real stained glass.

name: Time Flies 2D
concept: Six rainbow 'flies' wander erratically, speeds random-walking and headings veering via shared wave noise, dot radius pulsing like wings, soft-contained to the centre.
visual_verdict: Small, dim single-colour blobs scattered on black, spreading toward the edges; motion is plausible but the dots are tiny and sparse, so the panel looks mostly empty.
perf_smell: per-pixel loop over all flies with hypot (sprite-per-pixel) — renderBulk + splat per fly is the documented replacement
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec; no controls, fixed 6 flies, 1D renderer deliberately blank.
action_notes: Its erratic insect steering becomes a 'Swarm: flock | jitter flies' mode of boids-2d (rewritten at native res with renderBulk splat + fade() trails, fly count control); delete this file.

name: wanderedges
concept: Stationary additive green pulses through a palette that peaks at MID intensity and returns to black at max, so swelling pulses hollow out into bright wandering rims that merge and split.
technique: pulse pool + per-pixel accumulator + mid-peaked palette
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows thin bright green contour loops opening, merging into figure-eights and closing — genuinely distinctive and organic.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) + hand-cleared accumulator loop (fine on strips)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec's clever bit (mid-peaked palette) faithfully and fixes the pool bugs; no controls.
action_notes: Keep; add controls (rim colour picker, pulse lifetime s, spawn rate/s, footprint %), and a 2D variant where pulses are radial splats into a canvas (contour rings on a panel would look great) via renderBulk + paint loop.

name: wanderers
concept: A few dozen fixed-hue dots each random-walk one cell at a time on a 16x16 canvas; horizontal wrap, vertical clamp.
visual_verdict: Looks like static confetti noise: 2x2 coloured blocks scattered on black, barely distinguishable frame to frame.
perf_smell: hand-cleared canvas loop + render2D readout; frame-rate-dependent step probability
cleanroom_quality: Faithful (and fixes the hard-coded serpentine), but the idea is too thin to read as motion.
action_notes: Delete; wandering particles are better served by boids-2d / time-flies (merged).

name: Wavy Bands
concept: Vertical rainbow bands whose boundaries snake sideways (travelling sine) and breathe (perlin-warped y), bright centres with soft dark seams.
visual_verdict: Smooth red/green/cyan/purple seaweed columns undulating with dark seams; calm, clean lava-lamp drift.
perf_smell: perlin + sin + pow(v,1.4) per pixel (pow could be v*sqrt(v) or a square)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec closely with good real-unit controls.
action_notes: Keep; absorb halloween-wavy-bands as a palette option if it is the same idea, and swap pow(v,1.4) for a cheaper curve. Optional OKLCH band colours.

name: White Rainbows
concept: Near-white comet heads sweep both directions, leaving trails that re-saturate from white into vivid (18x repeated) rainbow colour and fade.
visual_verdict: Waterfall is a dense pastel honeycomb/mosaic of crossing trails with fine rainbow striping; busy and noisy rather than comet-like.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) mutated inside render(); frame-rate-dependent decay
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; it is the same crossing-head-pair mechanic as sound-starburst-2 minus the sound; both controls are 0..1 dials (one a pseudo-toggle).
action_notes: Merge the two into one 'Crossing Comets' pattern (keep starburst's file, rename) with a Sound-reactive toggle and a Rainbow repeat control; white-to-colour trail via renderBulk fade() plus a short white head; delete this file.

name: Wichmann–Hill PRNG
concept: Reusable seedable Wichmann-Hill PRNG with a debug surface, demoed as per-pixel random colour static.
visual_verdict: Flickering full-rainbow TV static with random brightness; unpleasant noise.
perf_smell: two software PRNG draws (with min/max bookkeeping) per pixel per frame, two array(pixelCount) — 0.49 ms/1024 px for noise
cleanroom_quality: Faithful utility; Luxel's own seedable random makes it redundant.
action_notes: Delete — a PRNG library is not library content, and the engine already provides deterministic seeding.

name: XmasFlies
concept: Slowed, wrapping fork of sparks: red/green/blue/gold fireflies drift both ways, slowing and dimming until they respawn elsewhere.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows lively crossing red, orange, green and blue streaks with short tails, like festive tracer sparks; colourful and energetic on a strip.
perf_smell: 4x array(pixelCount) energy buffers + 4 feedback calls per frame (renderBulk fade() + setPixel with the group colour does it with zero buffers)
cleanroom_quality: Implements the spec's 'fixed' variant (all four groups light); no controls.
action_notes: Becomes a 'Drift (wrap, slow, palette)' style of the unified Sparks pattern with a Palette option (ember | xmas RGBGold | rainbow) and spark count/drag controls; implement as renderBulk fade()+setPixel; delete the file.

name: xorcery 2D/3D
concept: Bitwise XOR of centred, scaled fixed-point coordinates gives reflected self-similar blocky cells; multi-rate clocks zoom, breathe and recolour them.
visual_verdict: Glitchy nested-square fractal blocks blooming in rainbow colour, sometimes a single diamond outline; distinctive 'digital' look that suits LED panels.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec with good real-unit controls.
action_notes: Keep as is; optionally add an OKLCH palette mode and reduce the near-black share (several frames are mostly dark).

name: zoom kaleidoscope
concept: XOR of Chebyshev and Manhattan ring fields gives a fractal moire that reads as an endless zoom, dressed in ridged noise, with optional wander, rocking rotation and spokes.
technique: per-pixel XOR fields + perlinRidge + temporal smoothing
visual_verdict: Rich, symmetric kaleidoscope mandalas in green/orange/blue/violet that change dramatically frame to frame; one of the most impressive sheets in the range.
perf_smell: 3-octave perlinRidge per pixel + two array(pixelCount) smoothing buffers + atan2 when spokes are on
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec and fixes its 'static plaid' problem with a real exponential zoom; four bare 0..1 dials (spokes quantised, zoom, smooth, contrast).
action_notes: Keep; controls to real units (spokes 0..8 step 1, smoothing seconds, contrast %), drop perlinRidge to 2 octaves or 1 for 64x64+, and replace the two pixelCount smoothing arrays with a cheaper approach (smoothing hue is barely visible — keep only brightness, or skip on large panels).
